title: The name chips over component copies stay clear of a sheet of components header row
goal: When Ask or an agent lays components out as a table, the purple name chip Photonz draws above every component copy sits on the table's header words, so on the canvas Hover, Pressed and Disabled are half covered. The canvas should show the table readably at normal zoom.
notes: Seen 2026-10-23 in queue/audits/2026-10-23-component-sheet-window-sc.png (Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/ask-builds-base-components-walk.json --no-build, 1-sheet-sc.png): each copy's chip (CanvasNames.canvasNameChips, drawNameChip in CanvasComponents.swift) is a fixed screen size just above the copy, so at zoom 0.67 it covers about 30 document points, over the header row the table sets 16 points above its first row (AgentComponentSheet.swift, AgentNewComponent.headerGap). Chips of a lower row also sit in the 32 point gap and touch the row above. The earlier layout put state names UNDER looks for this reason. Headers are named <State> Header, row names <Row> Label.
acceptance: On the canvas at the zoom a new picture opens at, no name chip covers a header word of a component sheet Ask made (window capture of ask-builds-base-components-walk)
Whatever the chips do instead (move, hide while a header already names the state, show on hover) still lets a person see which version a copy is
